faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to what travel agencies wonder about most.

salesIncrease.question: Does Turzz AI really increase my sales?
salesIncrease.answer: Yes. Customers get instant 24/7 replies, so no one drops off waiting. Our agencies see 30-50% more bookings on average in the first month. Late-night and weekend messages are converted fully automatically.

setup.question: How long does setup take?
setup.answer: If your WhatsApp Business account is ready, you go live in 15 minutes. You enter agency info, tours and prices in the panel; the bot learns automatically and starts responding.

whatsappCost.question: Is there a WhatsApp Business API fee?
whatsappCost.answer: Meta WhatsApp Business API charges a small per-message fee (~$0.01–$0.05). Turzz subscription doesn't include this — it's paid directly to Meta. Up to ~1,000 monthly active conversations are usually free.

payment.question: How do we collect payment?
payment.answer: Three options: (1) IBAN/bank transfer link, (2) cash/card at office, (3) cash on tour day. Your bot routes the customer to the chosen method. An integrated card payment module is coming.

tourLimit.question: Is there a tour limit?
tourLimit.answer: Starter plan: 10 tours; Professional: 30 tours; Enterprise: unlimited. You can upgrade anytime. Inactive tours don't count toward the limit.

cancellation.question: Can I cancel anytime?
cancellation.answer: Yes. Monthly subscriptions can be cancelled at the end of any month; your service continues until the end of the current billing period. You can export your data and customer records at any time.

addingTours.question: How do I add my tours?
addingTours.answer: Two options: (1) Manual entry — Use "New Tour" in the "Tours" tab to add tours one by one (title, price, program, transport, multilingual fields). (2) Bulk Excel import — For dozens of tours, click "Bulk Import", download the template, fill it in, and upload. Required fields (title, destination, type, currency) are marked in the template. Dates and prices are added separately for each tour.

tpl.duplicateId: The same __tour_id cannot appear in two rows. If it does, the first wins and the second is rejected.
tpl.updateNoTranslate: AI translation does NOT run automatically on update rows. Translate from the panel via 'Translate with AI'.
tpl.idSafetyReminder: NEVER delete/change __tour_id. If removed, the row becomes a 'new tour' insert (creates a duplicate).
tpl.colorRequired: Orange header = REQUIRED field. Cannot be empty.
tpl.colorOptional: Blue header = Optional. Fill in for richer bot answers; not mandatory.
tpl.colorSystem: Gray header = System field. DO NOT TOUCH — filled automatically.
